paper_title: Federated Learning-Enabled Hybrid Language Models for   Communication-Efficient Token Transmission
caption: Token Resolution Breakdown for FedHLM: Local, P2P, and LLM Token Distribution.
model_annotation: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of token routing within the FedHLM framework, specifically showing the proportion of tokens routed locally, via peer-to-peer (P2P) connections, and to a large language model (LLM). The chart consists of three slices. A large green slice, labeled “LOCAL”, occupies approximately 94.5% of the pie. A smaller red slice, labeled "EDGE_P2P", accounts for roughly 3.9% of the pie. The remaining blue slice, labeled “LLM”, represents about 1.6% of the total. Percentage labels are displayed within each slice. A legend is present, associating labels with colors. The slices appear ordered from largest to smallest based on their proportional size.
